svg.title: Measured and smoothed methane
svg.text: The measured value stays; the smoothed values are two more statements about it
geolod:measuredValue, geolod:smoothedValue_rollingMedian and geolod:smoothedValue_savgol of the methane observations, against age.
736 observations over 0 to 649 ka BP. A window of 11 points is about 8.8 ka on average along this record.
Both filters lean on neighbours: at the first observation there are none on one side, which is why the three values differ most there.
